name: Floor Skullcrusher Neutral Grip
description: Skullcrushers performed on the floor with dumbbells in a neutral grip (palms facing each other). The neutral grip reduces elbow stress compared to pronated variations and allows natural forearm rotation. The floor limits depth for added safety.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Floor Skullcrusher Neutral Grip in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Floor Skullcrusher Neutral Grip.
steps: Step 1: Lie on floor with dumbbells held at arm's length above chest, palms facing each other.
Step 2: Bend elbows to lower dumbbells toward temples keeping upper arms vertical.
Step 3: Lower until triceps contact floor or end of range.
Step 4: Extend elbows back to starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Rotating wrists out of neutral position
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Upper arms stay perpendicular to floor
